html:
One box with a title, an optional small tag and a short text. Use it inside Template:Tl, or on its own.

Usage 

{{InfoCard|title=Adds|type=danger|tag=Kill fast|The boss summons small monsters.}}
  • title is the heading of the card.
  • type picks the colour. Choose from info (default), danger, control, heal, debuff and reward.
  • tag (optional) is a small label on the right.
  • wide (optional) set to yes makes the card take a whole row in an Template:Tl.
  • The text is the first unnamed parameter. Write text= if it contains an equals sign.

A small titled box for mechanics, notes or facts. Put several inside InfoGrid.
